tactical_insights: Without Almirón, Julio Enciso carries Paraguay's creative burden against Australia's disciplined defense.
Paraguay needs a victory to guarantee progression, while Australia can advance with a draw.
Both managers, Alfaro and Popovic, favor disciplined defensive structures and swift counter-attacks.
